title: Regression: tracked cycle count and every other part dialog edit still save
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin. A tracked part with stock.
  • Parts > Inventory.
custom_steps:
1. ⋮ > Cycle count, type a count on the tracked row, Save.
  2. ⋮ > Cycle count again, type a count, click Cancel.
  3. Open a tracked part and change in turn: price, vendor, category, manufacturer, tags, add a bin, Fixed Price. Save each.
  4. Set Core Charge to 0 and Save.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Success; the count is applied.

Step 2:

  • The discard-changes dialog shows.

Step 3:

  • Each change saves and shows on the row.

Step 4:

  • The "Core Charge Warning" still shows.
